tex_content.html:
\begin{equation} \operatorname {Vol}_{g(T)}(C_{T,i})+\ell _T \leq \operatorname {Vol}_{g_T^*}(R_{T,i}), \end{equation}

or the event has zero caps, $\ell _T=0$, and a connected component outside $A_T^-$ has strictly positive incoming volume. Vanishing events have empty post-volume and are bounded by their supplied left-limit volume. The zero-cap alternative is deliberately not forced into a positive loss estimate.
